fact: Gartokkar reveals the true political landscape of Gracklstugh to the party.
source_quote: Gartokkar then drew the party aside and revealed the true political landscape of Gracklstugh
subject: Keepers' political landscape reveal

fact: The Keepers' power derives in equal measure from psionic abilities, the leadership of the Deepking, and influence over Themberchaud.
source_quote: in equal measure from our psionic abilities, the leadership of the Deepking, and our influence over Themberchaud
subject: Keepers of the Flame

fact: Themberchaud does not know that the Keepers are planning to replace him.
source_quote: The dragon had no idea that they were already planning to replace him
subject: Themberchaud

fact: A red dragon egg intended to hatch Themberchaud's successor was stolen.
source_quote: A red dragon egg, intended to hatch his successor, had been stolen
subject: red dragon egg

fact: The Gray Ghosts are a shadowy organization that stole the red dragon egg.
source_quote: had been stolen by a shadowy organization known as the Gray Ghosts
subject: Gray Ghosts

fact: The Keepers have been waging a quiet war against the Thieves Guild since the theft.
source_quote: the Keepers had been waging a quiet war against the Thieves Guild ever since
subject: Thieves Guild

fact: Thorin reveals that Themberchaud wants the party to report directly to him.
source_quote: When Thorin revealed that Themberchaud wanted the party to report directly to him
subject: direct reporting to dragon

fact: Gartokkar expresses gratitude for the tip regarding direct reporting.
source_quote: Gartokkar was grateful for the tip
subject: Gartokkar's gratitude

fact: Gartokkar insists that the old dragon would not be disposed of but set free.
source_quote: Gartokkar insisted that the old dragon would not be disposed of but "set free"
subject: Gartokkar

fact: Gartokkar describes a great psionic disturbance rippling through the Underdark.
source_quote: Gartokkar also described a great psionic disturbance rippling through the Underdark
subject: psionic disturbance description

fact: Gartokkar believes the Gray Ghosts are responsible for the psionic disturbance.
source_quote: which he believed the Gray Ghosts were responsible for
subject: Gray Ghosts

fact: The party's lore checks fail to turn up further clues about the disturbance.
source_quote: The party's lore checks failed to turn up any further clue about it
subject: lore check failure

fact: Droki is a derro messenger who carries messages and supplies for the Gray Ghosts.
source_quote: a derro messenger named Droki, who carried messages and supplies for the Gray Ghosts
subject: Droki

fact: Gartokkar tasks the party with tracking down Droki.
source_quote: He tasked the party with tracking down a derro messenger named Droki
subject: party task assignment

fact: Gartokkar tasks the party with recovering powerful magic that caused the disturbance.
source_quote: and with recovering whatever powerful magic had caused the disturbance
subject: party task assignment 2

fact: Gartokkar gives the party a holy symbol of Laduguer.
source_quote: he gave the party a holy symbol of Laduguer
subject: holy symbol of Laduguer

fact: Gartokkar gives the party gold pins bearing Themberchaud's profile.
source_quote: and gold pins bearing Themberchaud's profile
subject: gold pins

fact: The holy symbol and gold pins grant passage beyond the Darklake District.
source_quote: granting them passage beyond the Darklake District
subject: Darklake District

fact: Gartokkar threatens that refusal will result in the Stone Guards inventing a crime to charge the party with.
source_quote: refusal would result in the Stone Guards inventing an appropriate crime to charge them with
subject: Gartokkar's threat

fact: The party accepts the mission.
source_quote: The party accepted the mission
subject: party accepts mission

fact: Thorin suggests that the Stone Guards ought to know about the stolen egg.
source_quote: Thorin provocatively suggested that perhaps the Stone Guards ought to know about the stolen egg
subject: Thorin's provocation

fact: Gartokkar is thrown into barely concealed alarm by Thorin's suggestion.
source_quote: sending Gartokkar into barely concealed alarm
subject: Gartokkar

fact: Thorin states that the party will decide what to do with the egg when the time comes.
source_quote: Thorin simply replied that they would decide what to do with it when the time came
subject: Thorin's ambiguity

fact: Gartokkar calls the party "funny" through gritted teeth.
source_quote: left Gartokkar calling them "funny" through gritted teeth
subject: Gartokkar's reaction

fact: The group has a brief exchange about everyone's height.
source_quote: led to a brief exchange about everyone's height
subject: height exchange

fact: Thorin floats the idea of escaping on the back of a dragon.
source_quote: Thorin was already floating the idea of escaping "in a blaze of glory on the back of a dragon"
subject: Thorin

fact: The party operates as agents of the dragon, servants of the Keepers, and investigators for a Stone Guard captain simultaneously.
source_quote: as agents of the dragon who didn't know he was being replaced, as servants of the faction that was replacing him, and as investigators for a Stone Guard captain
subject: multiple fronts
